title.justification: Title stated at top of paper
title.value: A Survey on Deep Learning for Theorem Proving

extractions.description: A survey of more than 180 research papers on deep learning for theorem proving, reviewing tasks (autoformalization, premise selection, proofstep generation, proof search), datasets (collected and synthetically generated), evaluation metrics and state-of-the-art performance, plus challenges and future directions. The paper executes no experiments of its own; all reported numbers are quoted from the surveyed literature.

type.quote: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of deep learning for theorem proving
type.justification: It is a literature survey summarizing empirical results of other works; no theoretical contributions or proofs are made.

name.quote: In ITP, humans collaboratively prove theorems by interacting with proof assistants
name.justification: ITP described as paradigm of formal theorem proving reviewed
